svg.title: 3. Edge and offline behaviour
svg.text: Supermarket site, Greengrass gateway (WAN down 06:10 to 12:10)
Greengrass core device: industrial PC, 64 GB SSD
Heat pump at home, Wi-Fi down for 40 minutes
Edge and offline: a supermarket site keeps working through a 6-hour WAN outage, and a home device rides out a Wi-Fi drop
All components ship as one deployment to the thing group sites/eu;
recipes are versioned and artifacts live in S3.
Samples keep going into a 64 KB flash ring buffer: 1 per minute, about 40 bytes
each in CBOR, so 24 hours fit. The device timestamp travels with every sample.
Reconnect: exponential backoff with full jitter, 1 s doubling to a 5-minute cap,
so 180,000 homes on one broadband provider do not reconnect in the same second.
MQTT 5 with clean start = 0 and a 24 h session expiry: QoS 1 commands sent while
it was away are delivered on reconnect. The backlog uploads oldest first, at most
2 messages per second, and only after the device has received the latest shadow.
device gets a delta on reconnect
alert if a site is silent > 15 min
Late data is normal, not an error: every store
downstream keys on device time, not arrival time,
